title: COMMUNICATION FROM MAYOR relative to the appointment of Michael Chavez to the Board of Harbor Commissioners for the term ending June 30, 2027.
text:
[Council File 26-1200-S60]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM MAYOR relative to the appointment of Michael Chavez to the Board of Harbor Commissioners for the term ending June 30, 2027.
Financial Disclosure Statement
: Pending
Background Check
: Pending
RESOLVE that the Mayor's appointment of Michael Chavez to the Board of Harbor Commissioners for the term ending June 30, 2027, is APPROVED and CONFIRMED. Mr. Chavez currently resides in Council District 15. (Current composition: M= 1; F= 3; Vacant= 1)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 27, 2026
(LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - NOVEMBER 20, 2026)
(Trade, Travel, and Tourism Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)
summary: Council is asked to confirm the Mayor's appointment of Michael Chavez to the Board of Harbor Commissioners, a term ending June 30, 2027.
